quote.speaker: Walpurgis
quote.text: "I've heard that out in the western wastelands, they have a cure for every disease."

quote.speaker: Unknown
quote.text: "Really? I thought the pleasant part of the country was in the east."

quote.speaker: Walpurgis
quote.text: "Oh, it is. The west just has a very... permanent treatment. Becoming a Robian seems to eliminate every illness. And they do it for free in exchange for your freedom."
